item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The band of clouds covering southern China will thin out in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will improve gradually over the region, but it will remain cool in the morning. A strong replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China on Friday to early Saturday. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures will rise gradually over southern China early next week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines will develop slightly in the next couple of days, and move northeastwards generally.
